questions.prompt: At what fill level does Zephyr Cache start evicting entries?
questions.answer: When the arena is ninety percent full, least recently used first.
questions.sourceQuote: When the arena is ninety percent full

questions.answer: They are never evicted, even when the arena is full.
questions.sourceQuote: Entries marked pinned are never evicted

questions.prompt: How often does Zephyr Cache write a snapshot by default?
questions.sourceQuote: writes a snapshot to disk every five minutes by default

questions.prompt: How does the server recover after a crash?
questions.answer: It loads the newest complete snapshot and ignores partially written files.

questions.prompt: How many replicas can a primary node stream writes to?
Which replica promotes itself when the primary stops responding?
questions.answer: The replica with the highest sequence number.
questions.sourceQuote: the replica with the highest sequence number promotes itself

questions.prompt: What is the maximum key length?
questions.sourceQuote: Keys may be at most 250 bytes long
